name: Ricardo Benavidez
bio:
Ricardo's motorsport journey began in his teens, tinkering with go-karts in his hometown of Rosario. His passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he joined a small touring car team. He quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating an exceptional ability to balance technical understanding with effective team management. His approach to the sporting director role is characterized by a focus on long-term strategy and fostering a collaborative environment. Ricardo is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his knack for identifying and nurturing young talent.

At Full Time Sports, Ricardo aims to implement data-driven decision-making processes and improve communication between the engineering and driver departments. He believes that a cohesive team, driven by clear objectives and mutual respect, is the key to sustained success. He also is a strong advocate for investing in new technologies and exploring innovative strategies to gain a competitive edge. Ricardo's distinctive talent lies in his ability to translate complex technical information into actionable strategies for the entire team.
